⚡ We're hiring: Apprentice Electrician (Level 3) ⚡

Spark & Wire Electrical Ltd, Bristol 📍

Want a real trade with no student debt? Join our 4-year Level 3 Installation & Maintenance Electrician apprenticeship. You'll work alongside our qualified electricians on domestic rewires, new builds and commercial fit-outs, and spend one day a week at City of Bristol College.

👉 What we're looking for:
✅ GCSEs (grade 4/C or above) in Maths and English – or equivalent
✅ Genuine interest in electrical work
✅ Good with your hands and comfortable working at height
✅ Reliable, punctual, and willing to learn
✅ Full UK driving licence or working towards one (preferred)

👉 Not required: any previous experience or tools – we supply everything.

👉 What you get:
💷 £8.50/hr in year 1 rising every year
🎓 College fees fully covered
🧰 Free starter tool kit + PPE
🚐 Travel to site in company van

Applications close 28 February. Under-18s and career changers both welcome! #apprenticeship #electrician #Bristol
